items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: the Dland later died, so I stayed about a week more at the Bell Range, her funeral and everything

ctx.x: Then you came back to New Orleans and you stayed there.

Yeah, and then I, the second while I had, we would be together, then we'd separate, and we'd come back together, and I just, I came out to visit, and my people had bought a place on Corneyes Street, and I came, when I went back, the Dland later died, so I stayed about a week more at the Bell Range, her funeral and everything, and I came back in 48, all the way up until 65, and I went to take Mike's place after Chad Limited. I stayed there three years. And things was awful around, Chicago music, man.
How was it down here when you came back in?
